name: Daisy's De-Lites Deli Panini, Soup & Fresh Melon
whyItWorks: Daisy's De-Lites serves warm pressed deli paninis, rotating smooth soups, and freshly cut cantaloupe, honeydew, and watermelon (>90% hydrating water, ~0g insoluble fiber).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a bowl of ripe cantaloupe, honeydew, and banana slices, plus a turkey/ham and Swiss/cheddar panini or wrap (pull out any leafy greens or tomato slices). Skip the quinoa/raw kale grain bowls and seeded berries during flares.
watchOuts: Quinoa, raw kale, and chickpea salad bowls
Pineapple acidity and berry seeds at the fruit bar
